layout: flat — this run's maps/, findings/, verdicts/, REPORT.md, TICKETS.md and linear-ids.json sit directly under docs/audit/. Later runs live under docs/audit/runs/<baseline-date>/.

definitions.note: These five counts were originally recorded without their derivations, and the 2026-08-08 run had to reverse-engineer them by finding the commands that reproduce 676/53/25/218/71 at this revision. They are written down here so no future run has to do that again. Each is evaluated against git-tracked files at `revision`, never the working tree.
definitions.go_files: git ls-tree -r --name-only <rev> | grep -c '\.go$'  — every tracked .go file, tests included
definitions.packages: git ls-tree -r --name-only <rev> | grep '\.go$' | grep -v '_test\.go$' | xargs -n1 dirname | sort -u | wc -l  — directories holding at least one NON-test .go file; a test-only directory is not a package for this count
definitions.migrations: (count of postgres/migrations/*.sql) / 2  — migration PAIRS, not files; every migration is up+down, which is checked separately
definitions.frontend_files: git ls-tree -r --name-only <rev> | grep -cE '^web/src/.*\.(ts|tsx)$'  — .ts and .tsx only; the .css, .png and .html under web/src/ are excluded
definitions.env_vars: git show <rev>:.env.example | grep -cE '^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*='  — assignment lines in .env.example; commented and blank lines excluded. NAMES only are ever recorded, never values, and no real .env is read
